findings: Flatten the rim ring: the stave tops stand too proud and read as knobs from the front and side.
Keep the foot ring distinct so the base reads as a ring, not a closed dome.
cards.name: wash-basin-b
cards.notes: Scores [3.5,4,3.5,4,4,4,3.5,3.5,4,4]. Wide staved bowl with 2 iron hoops, bright water, and a dipper across the rim. The lumpy rim is the one clear difference from the mockup.

findings: Thin the legs toward the feet: the lower legs read thicker than the mockup frame.
Add the cream fringe at the towel hem and the rope ties at the rail and leg joints.
cards.name: towel-rack-a
cards.notes: Scores [4,4,3.5,4,4,4,3.5,4,4,4]. A-frame stand with a wide cream towel, teal stripe, lower rail, and side hand towel. Close to the mockup with small differences only.

findings: 1. Seat the middle teal slab flat on the bottom towel and close the side gaps; the middle layer hovers at its edges.
2. Reshape the top corner tab into a flat folded corner that hangs over the stack edge.
3. Merge the thin cream layer into the bottom towel; the stack must read as 3 slabs, not 4.
cards.name: towel-stack-a
cards.notes: Scores [3,3,2.5,3,4,3,2.5,3,3.5,3.5]. Three cloth colors read, but the middle slab hovers and the stack reads as 4 layers with a tab. Noticeably off in body plan.

findings: Add the rope ties at the top rail and leg joints, and a short cream fringe at the towel hem.
cards.name: towel-rack-b
cards.notes: Scores [4.5,4.5,4,4.5,4,4,4,4.5,4.5,4]. Clean A-frame with a narrow cream towel, teal stripe, lower rail, and side hand towel on an iron peg. Very close to the mockup.

findings: Shorten the dipper handle so the dipper rests across the rim instead of reaching past it in side view.
cards.name: wash-basin-a
cards.notes: Scores [4.5,4.5,4,4.5,4,4,4,4.5,4.5,4.5]. Clean staved basin with a smooth pale rim, 2 iron hoops, bright water, and a dipper on the rim. Very close to the mockup.

findings: Soften the hanging corner flap so it reads as a folded cloth corner, not a stiff tab.
Add the 2 rolled folds at the bottom towel front edge.
cards.name: towel-stack-b
cards.notes: Scores [3.5,4,3.5,3.5,4,3.5,3.5,3.5,4,4]. Three-slab stack in cream, teal, and terracotta with a stitched band and an overhanging corner. Same object with clear differences in fold softness.
